records.why: Journal item bio_3_2-148 (teacher: 'Match with KICD', EDIT): the teacher wants the Final Explanation rubric to match KICD. KICD's own assessment rubrics use four levels (Exceeds, Meets, Approaches, Below Expectations) but the partner contract has only three level fields, so no structure change is made. Deferred: rubric, pending the partner. Please confirm that 'match KICD' means the four-level rubric only, or whether specific KICD descriptor wording is wanted.
